capabilities.en: Replaces Adobe After Effects' native Graph Editor with a modern, normalized easing-curve editor
Ships with 25 built-in easing curves based on Robert Penner's easing functions
Library system to save, reuse and share custom easing presets across projects, with multi-library support
Exports easing curves as CSS cubic-bezier values for handoff to web developers
